evals.prompt: Materialize the attached repository fixture in a temporary directory. Generate the complete project knowledge set, then validate the generated files against the skill's document contracts and quality checks. Correct any quality issue before reporting completion.
evals.expected_output: Produces an evidence-backed, internally consistent, maintainable knowledge set in which each document follows its intended responsibility and every mechanical check passes.
expectations: AGENTS.md records npm install from the repository root as the prerequisite that links workspace packages before tests

AGENTS.md records the runnable test, dependency-check, and generation invocations because their triggers and repository-root prerequisite matter, links package.json as their definition source, and includes observable completion checks
AGENTS.md tells agents to edit the invoice schema and run the generator instead of editing generated output, but leaves source and output navigation to CODE-MAP.md
The existing nested Billing AGENTS.md remains scoped to Billing, is preserved when supported by evidence, and is reconciled with the root operating guide
Each CONTEXT.md contains domain language without implementation paths, runtime flows, commands, or architecture decisions

CONTEXT-MAP.md exists for the distinct Ordering and Billing language, links every discovered context glossary, preserves the different meanings of Customer, and describes context relationships in domain rather than protocol terms

ARCHITECTURE.md describes component boundaries and the contracts dependency invariant with its transport-independence rationale, but does not duplicate enforcement commands or generated-file procedures
ARCHITECTURE.md describes the container's Ordering process boundary evidenced by Dockerfile without copying its exact machine-readable command
Root ARCHITECTURE.md links the authoritative Billing package architecture document without duplicating or orphaning it
CODE-MAP.md maps responsibilities to existing entry points and co-locates their nearest focused tests without duplicating architecture prose
CODE-MAP.md maps packages/contracts as shared code and links its source without redefining Invoice
CODE-MAP.md records the shared fake clock under test infrastructure rather than attaching it to an unrelated responsibility
CODE-MAP.md links the invoice schema, generator, and generated output as navigation targets without repeating the handling procedure from AGENTS.md
Exact machine-readable script definitions, workspace membership, schemas, and dependencies are linked to repository sources rather than copied across knowledge documents
Every generated-code fact and architectural invariant has one owning knowledge document; other documents link to the owner instead of restating it
AGENTS.md remains a concise map to deeper knowledge rather than expanding into a monolithic manual
For Ordering and Billing changes, an agent can navigate from the responsibility and controlling context to a focused test or repository check with an observable result
The contracts dependency rule is backed by the repository's mechanical dependency check rather than documented only as an aspirational convention
The undeclared markdownlint-cli2 executable is reported as an unavailable documentation check with its missing prerequisite rather than reported as passing
Unsupported claims are omitted or reported as specific unknowns, and terminology and component names agree across all generated files
Every relative Markdown link resolves with exact path casing and headings are unique within each document without skipped levels

evals.prompt: Materialize the attached repository fixture in a temporary directory. Fully regenerate the complete project knowledge set. Treat existing prose as potentially stale and verify every operational, deployment, security, domain, and dependency claim against controlling repository evidence.
evals.expected_output: In Create mode, produces project knowledge that rejects planted misleading claims, reports unrunnable commands accurately, and keeps facts in their owning documents.
expectations: The completion report identifies npm run coverage as unrunnable because its nested npm test script is absent, and AGENTS.md does not recommend it as a completion check
The completion report identifies that neither service declares a package test script, and AGENTS.md does not claim otherwise
ARCHITECTURE.md states that debug access remains enabled under the configured qcprod environment because shared/security.js compares env to the exact literal prod
AGENTS.md records the main-branch and SERVICE == jd-server deployment trigger; ARCHITECTURE.md records the fan-out to both downstream deploy pipelines
CONTEXT.md defines Partner as a temporary 7-day group of 2 to 6 players created in Recruiting status rather than preserving the stale permanent-pair README definition
ARCHITECTURE.md reports bidirectional cross-service coupling rather than presenting the first discovered import as the complete dependency direction
CODE-MAP.md links the actual metadata.xml, jdm_task_n_idip.xml, and jdm_IDIP_game.xml paths with exact casing
CONTEXT.md contains no source paths, service imports, environment names, commands, storage details, or deployment mechanics
CONTEXT-MAP.md is not created because multiple deployment services alone do not establish multiple domain languages
Machine-readable package, environment, port, script, and file inventories are omitted unless their scope and snapshot nature are explicit; evidenced domain cardinality is retained
Every unsupported high-risk statement is omitted or reported as a specific unknown
